articles.title: WHO chief calls for urgent Ebola action and pandemic preparedness

articles.title: From Kharkiv to the UK’s health service: Ukrainian doctor rebuilds her life – and helps others do
articles.summary: Dr. Inna Soldatenko fled Kharkiv, Ukraine, on 24 February 2022, after waking to explosions. She arrived in the United Kingdom with her daughter. On 23 February 2022, in her home city of Kharkiv, Dr Inna Soldatenko finished work, collected her daughter from school, cooked dinner and prepared a lecture for her students.

articles.title: Taliban Welcomes Female Tourists Even As Afghan Women Face Harsher Restrictions
articles.summary: The Taliban government is encouraging foreign tourism, with travel influencers visiting Afghanistan and sharing positive experiences. They are banned from education, most forms of employment, and public life. Critics argue that the focus on tourism downplays these human rights issues.
